headline: Godcrofts Surges as Berm, Hollow and Shelf Stay Active
war_summary: Latest returns show Godcrofts surging to eleven changes in two hours and twenty in the day around Fleecewatch, Isawa and Ursa Base, counted at three Warden and six Colonial posts, while Palantine Berm holds at ten in two hours and fifty-three in the day around Vendett and Windburn Landing, counted at two Warden, four Colonial and one neutral. Marban Hollow posts six in two hours and thirty-six in the day around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, counted at two Warden, four Colonial and two neutral, and Stlican Shelf revives to five in two hours and thirteen in the day centered on Breaker Town, counted at one Warden, seven Colonial and one neutral. Weathered Expanse eases to two in two hours against forty-eight in the day around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, counted at five Warden posts with four neutral, and Farranac Coast adds two in two hours and seven in the day at Transient Valley, counted at one Warden and ten Colonial. Linn Mercy and Stonecradle fall silent in two hours despite thirty-four and twenty-one changes in the day, while Callahan's Passage reports heavy losses without a flip.
